Product Marketing Specialist (Contractor), amaran
Location: Los Angeles (Hybrid Option Available)
Reporting Structure: This role will report to the Global Product Marketing Manager, amaran

About the Aputure amaran brand
amaran is lighting the way for the next generation of creators. Whether you're filming in your home studio, vlogging on the move, or turning any space into your canvas, amaran empowers creators to take their content to the next level.

Overview
As a Product Marketing Specialist (Contractor) at amaran, you will support the Global Product Marketing team in bringing new products to market. This role will help turn market and competitor research into insights that shape our products for content creators, streamers, and podcasters across lighting, audio, and visual product lines; write clear and compelling product copy; and keep our launch assets organized and easy to use for teams around the world.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is curious about creators and the tools they use, loves research, writing, or both, and wants to grow their product marketing skills at a fast-moving global brand.

Qualifications
3+ years of experience in product marketing or a related field, ideally in consumer tech.
Proven experience conducting market, competitor, and customer research, and synthesizing findings into clear, actionable insights.
Strong copywriting, positioning, and messaging skills, with the ability to translate technical product specs into clear, benefit-driven copy.
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
Effective communication skills to collaborate across departments.
Self-starter who can work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with the creator, streaming, or podcasting space, or experience with lighting, audio, camera, or other prosumer electronics, is preferred.
Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese (speaking, reading, and writing) is preferred.

Primary Responsibilities
Market & Competitor Research: Conduct market and competitor research on products, features, pricing, and launches to develop insights that inform product development and positioning.
User Sentiment: Gather and analyze user sentiment from reviews, forums, social media, and video comments, and share key takeaways with the product marketing and product teams.
Market Trends Tracking: Track trends across the creator, streaming, and podcasting communities, and identify opportunities for new products, features, and accessories.
Copywriting: Write and edit product copy across touchpoints, including product pages, product descriptions, one-sheets, launch emails, and social captions, in line with amaran's brand voice.
Creator-Facing Messaging: Translate technical specs into creator-facing benefits that are easy to understand, and keep product copy consistent and up to date across new and existing products.
Product Surveys: Create product surveys for creators, KOLs, and customers and summarize findings into actionable insights for the product team.
Sales & Dealer Enablement: Assist with sales and dealer enablement materials, such as product FAQs, training decks, and retailer content.
Asset Organization: Organize and maintain product launch asset libraries, including naming conventions and version control, and help maintain creative asset toolkits so global and regional teams can easily find the latest materials.
Product Support: Support the product marketing team with product specification sheets, comparison charts, and research inputs for product briefs.
Launch Reporting: Assist with compiling post-launch performance reports, sharing insights and learnings for future launches.

Compensation
$35 to $40 per hour, based on experience and qualificationsHy
